title.en: The third incident at an uncertified kitchen
title.id: Insiden ketiga di dapur tanpa sertifikat higiene

summary.en: A kitchen without a hygiene certificate has its third incident in two months; the first two were closed as isolated cases.
summary.id: Dapur tanpa sertifikat laik higiene mengalami insiden ketiga dalam dua bulan; dua insiden sebelumnya ditutup sebagai kasus tunggal.

evidence.label: Open drain running beside the cooking area

reports.narrative: Ini sudah ketiga kalinya sejak Agustus. Dapurnya dekat selokan terbuka dan setahu kami belum punya sertifikat.

evidence.label: Kitchen notice board without a hygiene certificate (SLHS)

signals.headline: Sembilan siswa Wanasekar mual, dinas sebut kasus tunggal
signals.excerpt: Dinas menyatakan kejadian bersifat insidental dan dapur tetap beroperasi.

signals.headline: Keluhan kedua dari dapur MBG Wanasekar, belum ada inspeksi
signals.excerpt: Belum ada jadwal inspeksi ke dapur. Pengelola mengaku sertifikat laik higiene masih dalam proses.

signals.headline: Siswa makan terlambat, dapur diminta tepat waktu
signals.excerpt: Makanan dikonsumsi lewat dari empat jam. Dapur diminta mempercepat distribusi.

witness_script.question: Apakah dapur sudah memiliki sertifikat laik higiene sanitasi?
witness_script.answer: Belum. Sudah diajukan sejak Juli, tapi belum pernah ada petugas yang datang memeriksa.

witness_script.question: Apa tindak lanjut setelah kejadian Agustus dan September?
witness_script.answer: Tidak ada. Dua-duanya disebut kasus tunggal, dapurnya jalan terus seperti biasa.

witness_script.question: Bagaimana kondisi sekitar dapur?
witness_script.answer: Ada selokan terbuka di samping tempat masak, kalau hujan airnya meluap.

root_cause.statement: An uncertified kitchen keeps operating; earlier incidents were closed as isolated without inspection, so the hygiene problem is never fixed.

contributing.statement: Open drain beside the cooking area.
Meals eaten 4 h 20 min after cooking on the latest day.

answer_key.pattern: Third incident at the same kitchen in two months; each was closed as a one-off, nobody linked them.
distractors: Late eating time alone (it was late once, but the earlier incidents were on time).
